pages.text: Keys show as you bound them: the jar menu is $(k:key.headinajar.jar_menu).$(br2)JEI shows recipes; Jade reads bodies, hosts and mecha. Use a pile or power block empty-handed to see its charge.$(br2)Advancements are your to-do list.

Two controls on one key? Another mod may share it: the key shows in red on the Options, Controls screen. Rebind one of the two there. The ability key and sprint may share a key on purpose; the game says so the first time.
